summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the standard interface for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and APIs, with 2026 marking the shift to remote, OAuth-secured hosted endpoints from vendors like GitHub, Vercel, Linear, and Stripe. The ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations, gateways that proxy and secure traffic, and individual servers that expose specific capabilities. MCP matters because it lets any compatible client (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, custom agents) discover and call tools in a uniform, structured way without bespoke integration code.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (Composio, Smithery, mcp.so) are marketplaces/hubs that expose many servers through one endpoint, gateways (Cloudflare MCP, Kong, agentgateway) proxy and secure MCP traffic with auth/observability, and individual servers (GitHub, Playwright, Figma) each expose a single tool or service's capabilities.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Repos, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search and management across GitHub
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; usage tied to existing GitHub subscription
strengths: Deep integration with Copilot and Claude Desktop
Automates full repo and CI/CD workflows
tools.best_for: Automating repository management and development workflows from an AI agent

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, web navigation, scraping, and UI testing via Playwright
strengths: Top pick for Cursor web automation tasks
tools.best_for: Giving agents reliable browser control for testing and web automation

tools.name: Filesystem MCP
tools.connects_to: Local file read/write, directory operations, and file search on the host machine
strengths: Essential for local coding agents in Cursor
tools.best_for: Enabling agents to read and edit local project files

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps and tools (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Jira) through a single managed MCP layer
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers for higher volume and enterprise features
strengths: Managed auth across hundreds of integrations
Strong Cursor and agent framework support
tools.best_for: Rapidly giving agents access to many SaaS integrations without wiring each one

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP server hosting, OAuth, and edge deployment of MCP endpoints
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans for higher usage and compute
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting with OAuth
tools.best_for: Deploying secure, remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Design files, components, and Dev Mode data for design-to-code workflows
tools.pricing_paid: Requires Figma paid seats for Dev Mode features
strengths: Popular in Cursor UI generation flows
tools.best_for: Converting Figma designs into code with AI agents

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres database, auth, storage, and project management on Supabase
tools.pricing_paid: Tied to Supabase project plans (Pro and above)
strengths: Full database and backend control for agents
tools.best_for: Letting agents query and manage Supabase backends

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Registry of thousands of MCP servers with one-click install and hosting
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting/usage tiers for deployed servers
tools.best_for: Discovering and deploying community MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Slack MCP Server (korotovsky)
tools.connects_to: Slack channels, messages, and workspace data without admin approval in many setups
strengths: Most widely adopted Slack MCP (~1,800 GitHub stars)
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to Slack workspaces for messaging and search

tools.name: Docker MCP (MCP Toolkit / Catalog)
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers run and secured via Docker Desktop MCP Toolkit and Catalog
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Business/Team subscriptions for org features
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers in isolated, reproducible containers

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: Directory of thousands of MCP servers and clients for discovery
strengths: High search traffic for MCP discovery
tools.best_for: Finding the right MCP server from a broad public directory

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspace content via official hosted endpoint
strengths: Reads and writes structured workspace data
tools.best_for: Letting agents manage Notion docs and databases

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Error tracking, issues, and performance monitoring data in Sentry
strengths: Brings production error context to agents
tools.best_for: Giving agents access to error and performance telemetry for debugging
